summary: DRAMMEN ØYELEGESENTER AS (org. no. 997 862 953) is a private limited company (AS) based in Drammen, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2012-01-31. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 86.210 (Allmennlegetjenester). In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 10.7 m and net income was NOK 413 107. CEO: Lars Elsrud Nes; board chair: Tore Rytter Evensen; auditor: BDT VIKEN AS.
